title: Analytics edge hybrid replication orchestrator: lease-backed buffer & tenant-pin strategy
creator: Ava Chen
description: Implement an orchestration layer for analytics replication that uses an edge-buffered, lease-backed hybrid replication model. Goal: enable low-latency write-acceptance in a serving region while guaranteeing eventual placement of analytics events into the tenant-designated residency region and providing quarantine & TTL controls when regional policy prevents immediate replication. This ticket covers the coordinator service, CDC adapter changes, schema markers for residency, and an operator-facing audit view in the Console backend.
acceptance_criteria: Coordinator accepts writes in any serving region and persists a local immutable event with residency tag
Lease system ensures only one regional flusher per tenant-residency pair to avoid duplicate downstream writes
CDC adapter transforms local immutable events into residency-aware messages and backfills when leases move
Quarantine path stores events for up to tenant-configured TTL and surfaces counts in Console audit view
End-to-end tests cover immediate local acceptance, cross-region eventual replication, and failure/retry semantics
Datadog dashboard shows per-tenant replication lag, lease ownership, and quarantine volume with alert thresholds
comments: 2026-02-18 - Ava Chen: Initial ticket created after architecture spike. Spike showed 60-90ms p99 local acceptance with small memory overhead for in-region edge buffer. Decided to pursue lease-backed flusher to avoid duplicate cross-region writes.

2026-02-23 - Luca Martinez: Prototype coordinator started. Using small append-only immutable event store per region and a lightweight lease table in our metadata service. Need to align on schema markers for GDPR-sensitive fields before CDC emits to remote regions.

2026-03-01 - Priya Singh (Security): Requested KMS-encrypted tombstone for quarantined events and audit trail retention policy. Marked security_review_required. Action: add encryption-at-rest flag and KMS key id param to coordinator config.

2026-03-04 - Platform Review (comments): Concern about coupling lease ownership to single metadata shard; suggested using a consistent-hash ring per-residency to allow shard failover. Follow-up: spike to evaluate ring-based failover (ENG-48399).

2026-03-08 - Luca Martinez: Implemented idempotent cross-region writer using event uuid + residency marker; tests show duplicates suppressed after simulated flusher restart. Performance regression: extra 8% CPU on coordinator under synthetic load — profiling scheduled.

2026-03-12 - PM feedback (Samir Patel): Add operator UI row-level ability to increase quarantine TTL per-tenant and manual replay button in Console. Logged follow-up sub-issue ENG-48327-1 for UI work.

2026-03-12 - QA (Maya Lopez): Test plan drafted covering partial replication, network partitions, and tenant migration scenarios. Identified flaky case when lease handoff occurs during CDC backfill; adding jitter to handoff to mitigate.
2026-03-12 - Links: Incident learnings from related regional failover: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Incident-2025-11-geo-failover-summary
notes: Trade-offs: optimistic local acceptance improves app latency but increases complexity around duplication and auditability. Lease-backed flusher chosen to balance complexity and correctness.
Operational runbook needs: how to revoke a lease, force replay from quarantine, and perform emergency evacuation of a region's buffer
Rollout plan: start with internal-only tenants in eu-west-1 -> us-east-1 residency flows, monitor replication lag and quarantine rates for 2 weeks, then graduate to broader tenant set
